tagline: Chinon数码单反相机，1988 年发布
description: Chinon于1988年推出的数码单反相机。使用35mm film with speeds of 25 to 5000 ISO, with auto DX, 6 to 6400 ISO manual。

specs.胶片/画幅: 35mm film with speeds of 25 to 5000 ISO, with auto DX, 6 to 6400 ISO manual
specs.曝光测光: TTL full aperture center weighted average. 2x S.P.D. (Silicon Photo Diode).
specs.电池: 1x 6V 2CR5 battery (up to 70 rolls) or 4x 1.5V AA-type batteries (up to 60 rolls)
specs.英文简介: The CP-9AF Multi Program camera is an autofocus and autoexposure SLR introduced by Chinon in 1988.
